lead: Page navigation, data-driven: the caller owns the current page and the total, so it works for both server- and client-side paging. The buttons and the dropdown reuse the theme style of Button and Select.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: In `pagination.css` a theme style only handles layout and text: the buttons look like `button.css`, the page-size dropdown like `select.css`.
styling.root: The outer element: the two sides laid out apart
styling.info: The summary text and "Page x / y"
styling.controls: The controls on the right, the navigation buttons, the page numbers
styling.extras: The ellipsis and the page-size dropdown
